programs.title: These Foolish Things
programs.desc: A struggling young actress, a fledgling director and an ambitious playwright become embroiled in an emotional love triangle as they strive for recognition, fame and fortune in a world on the brink of World War II.

programs.title: A Little Something for Your Birthday
programs.desc: Senna Berges, a clothing designer trying to figure things out, has pretty much lost hope in finding her true love. Even though her best friend and pushy mom want her to focus on fashion design and settle down, Senna can’t stop her wild choices. After getting fired from several jobs and having random flings with younger guys, she finally meets Adam, a charming lawyer.

programs.title: 3 Hearts
programs.desc: A tax inspector, his new bride and her sister become entwined in a love triangle.

programs.title: The Walking Deceased
programs.desc: When a police officer wakes up in a hospital to find out he is in the middle of a zombie apocalypse, he will do anything to find his family, even sacrifice Twitter. The Walking Deceased is an hilarious spoof of The Walking Dead is about to spread. The story follows a group of survivors from all walks of the apocalypse - an idiotic Sheriff, his belligerent son, four squabbling friends, and a lonely zombie. They all leave their safe hideouts in search of the Safe Haven Ranch, a refuge untouched by the zombie virus.

programs.title: Hooligan Escape - The Russian Job
programs.desc: A gritty and brutal British crime thriller exploring the ultra-violent underbelly of football hooligan culture. Five English football fans have a violent encounter with a group of Russian hooligans at the European Cup. Their fight leaves one man dead and a vengeful Russian with an axe to grind.

programs.title: Romance Retreat
programs.desc: After a big breakup, journalist Dana Willingham finds herself alone and stuck at a couple’s yoga retreat while the biggest story of her career breaks far away. And she doesn’t even like yoga! But maybe the universe has put her here for a reason, because the handsome loner staying at the lodge turns out to be Stefan Gonzales, the tech guru at the center of the scandal. As she gains his trust to expose him, she finds herself falling in love with him. Now she must use the lessons from yoga to choose: the perfect story or the perfect man?
